subject: Correction: no click-to-refresh; dashboard must auto-update
body:
Correction to my previous stale-banner assignment. I was wrong to make manual refresh the primary path.

The product rule is now:

1. Normal state: when digest changes, the dashboard auto-loads the new state. The user should not click.
2. Interrupt protection only:
   - if a text field is focused or has unsent text, defer update and show a quiet inline affordance;
   - if the user has deliberately scrolled an active reading history (not merely opened it), defer long enough to avoid losing place, then preserve/restore scroll;
   - otherwise apply immediately.
3. No global warning on every page. A refresh is not an error.
4. No full-page navigation/remount.
5. Keep selected route/query, selected task/thread, drawer/dialog state, composer draft, and reading position across state reload.
6. E2E must prove automatic refresh without focus/drag, plus deferred refresh with draft preserved when composer has focus, and no `the record has moved` global alert.

Please replace the previous acceptance criteria with this.
